_note: Hand-written answer key for what read-brief should produce from briefs/brief-a.md. Lives in dev/: never read by a builder run.

call_variables.title: Mr or Ms
call_variables.now: current date and time; all date rules use it

opening.first_sentence: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and a recording of this call is kept.

questions.ask: what is your date of birth?
what are the last four digits of the phone number on file?

hints.day_month_swapped: Ask them to say the month as a word. This retry is not a wrong answer.

on_failed.say: use the mobile app or a branch

on_declined.counts_as_declining: asking what the call is about instead of answering

debt_statement: I am calling from the collections team about a late payment
first_ask: Can you make this payment today?

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: illness, a death in the family or job loss
special_cases.action: one short sentence of sympathy, no persuasion, offer the customer support team once

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: a new payment plan or lower instalments

special_cases.name: paid
special_cases.action: say payments can take one business day to appear, take no promise

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: not mine, never had it, or closed or paid off in the past
special_cases.action: do not argue, take no promise

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.action: ask once whether you can help first; if they insist, transfer

deceased.say: I am sorry for your loss.

required_sentences.text: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
I am sorry for your loss.
required_sentences.when: someone says the customer has died

robot_question: say you are Freya Bank's digital assistant and continue
scam_question: say they can verify the call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number, and continue
never_offer: any term not in the brief
